disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 6:30: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

first_reader_said: 1CH 6:30: Both records are Asaiah son of Haggiah in Merari's line.

why: Both records identify the Asaiah who is Haggiah’s son in the same Merarite genealogy at 1CH 6:30. A’s additional references identify Asaiah as chief of Merari’s sons and a Levite summoned by David (1CH 15:6, 15:11), which fits that lineage. B is a thinner duplicate with no distinguishing ancestry, generation, or role.
